title: Photonic line-graph flat band, apartment compact states, H1 tight frame, local address law, and disorder boundary
purpose: Translate the exact 160-coupler H1 theorem into a line-graph flat-band construction. Prove the -2 flat band, show that the 1620 Levi apartments are compact localized states spanning it as a unit-norm tight frame, and state the exact robustness boundary under uniform versus local perturbations.
result: The secondary 160-site Levi line graph satisfies A_X=D^T D-2I, so its -2 flat band is exactly the 81-dimensional H1 cycle space. All 1620 Levi apartments are compact eight-site flat-band states spanning that band; after normalization they form a unit-norm tight frame with frame bound 20. Every site lies in 81 apartments. Uniform onsite shifts preserve the degeneracy, while a one-site perturbation has rank-one projected action with eigenvalue 81/160, excluding generic disorder immunity.
coordination: BT548 owns the earlier algebraic line-graph projector theorem. This packet adds the secondary photonic model, apartment compact-state frame, exact local address law, and perturbation boundary without relabeling BT548.
boundary: Exact finite graph, line-graph, eigenspace, apartment-frame, and first-order projected perturbation statements only. External flat-band literature is context. No fabricated secondary lattice, measured localization, disorder tolerance, local synthesis, variable vacuum c, hidden photon nodes, remote CI, or laboratory performance is promoted.
